media.title: Media
media.subtitle: All your pictures, videos and audio in one place: what you uploaded and what the app made. Files stay on this computer.

delete.oneAsk: "{name}" will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
delete.manyAsk: {n} file will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone. | {n} files will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
delete.manyInUse: {n} of them is used somewhere else and will be kept. | {n} of them are used somewhere else and will be kept.
delete.blocked: Not deleted because it is in use: {names} | Not deleted because they are in use: {names}

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.text: Upload pictures, videos or audio, or make something in the chat: results land here by themselves.
empty.filteredText: No files match these filters. Change them or reset.

tile.usedTitle: Used in {n} place | Used in {n} places

viewer.name: Name
viewer.nameHint: Only the name in the library changes; the file itself stays the same.
viewer.missing: This file is no longer in the library.

ingest.title: Preview
ingest.busyVideo: Making a cover picture and a short preview…
ingest.busyAudio: Reading the length of the recording…
ingest.failed: Could not prepare the preview. The file itself is fine.
ingest.doneVideo: Cover picture and preview are ready.
ingest.doneAudio: Length of the recording is known.

usages.title: Where it is used
usages.unknown: Could not check where this file is used, so it cannot be deleted right now. Try again later.
usages.none: Not used anywhere. It can be deleted.
usages.blocked: While the file is used here, it cannot be deleted. Remove it from these places first.

upload.hint: Pictures up to {image} MB, videos up to {video} MB, audio up to {audio} MB. You can also drag files onto this page.
upload.queueBusy: Uploading: {n} file left | Uploading: {n} files left
upload.leaveAsk: {n} file is still uploading. If you leave this page, the upload stops. | {n} files are still uploading. If you leave this page, the upload stops.

storage.title: On disk
storage.serviceHint: Intermediate files the app made along the way. Old ones are cleaned up by themselves; your uploads are never touched.
storage.lowDisk: Little free space is left. Long videos may not fit: delete what you do not need.
